F. End-to-End Transformer Decoding: We reuse the BCJRFormer models from Section V-B and train each ECCT outer decoder on the outputs produced by the inner decoder for a channel configuration with equal insertion and deletion rates (p I = p D ) and a substitution probability of p S = 0.012.
